group_norms.norm_text: Plans are confirmed at least 48 hours in advance so everyone can arrange their schedules.
The group chat is kept light — no heavy personal venting or political arguments in the main thread.
Everyone contributes equally to shared costs on group trips — no separate billing.
When someone can't make a plan, they give as much notice as possible.
